name: digup-search
title: DigUp Search
description: Search your files by what's in them with DigUp: pictures, PDFs, documents, recordings, videos and code.
author: roy_jiang

commands.name: search-files
commands.title: Search Files
commands.subtitle: DigUp
commands.description: Describe what you're looking for and find the picture, page, moment or code that matches. Requires DigUp 0.6.1 or newer.

preferences.name: player
preferences.title: Open Videos and Recordings In
preferences.description: The app that opens videos and recordings. QuickTime Player, VLC and IINA start at the moment that matched; other apps start at the beginning. A file QuickTime Player can't play (MKV, WebM, FLAC…) opens in its default app instead.
